# githubenterprise_team_membership (Resource)

Manages one direct team membership. Other members are unaffected. Do not use with IdP-managed team memberships.

## Example

```hcl
resource "githubenterprise_team_membership" "example" {
  enterprise_slug = "my-enterprise"
  team_id         = githubenterprise_team.example.team_id
  username        = "octocat"
}
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Requirement | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enterprise_slug` | `String` | Required | Enterprise account slug. |
| `id` | `String` | Read-only | enterprise_slug/team_id/username. |
| `team_id` | `Number` | Required | Numeric team ID. Remains stable when a team is renamed. |
| `user_id` | `Number` | Read-only | Numeric GitHub user ID. |
| `username` | `String` | Required | GitHub username. |

## Import

```sh
terraform import githubenterprise_team_membership.example my-enterprise/123456/octocat
```

See the [provider guide](https://github.com/vmvarela/terraform-provider-github-enterprise#authentication) for authentication, ownership and compatibility requirements.
